lines.text: Wait! Does Cracking Knuckles Really Hurt Your Bones!
Most kids guess totally wrong about what happens when you crack knuckles!
Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
The loud pop comes from tiny harmless gas bubbles snapping inside.
joint fluid—not bones grinding—and research shows it does not cause arthritis.
Nature uses amazing science tricks right under our noses!
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
Now you know the real truth behind Gas Bubble Pop!
